title: Density of Forces Producing Navier--Stokes Blowup
summary: We study the density of smooth external forces for which the three-dimensional Navier--Stokes equations lose classical regularity by a prescribed time $T>0$. Starting from the compact forced blowup solution of OpenAI, we construct a blowup solution near every given smooth solution while preserving its initial velocity. A smooth cutoff of a local vector potential makes the given velocity vanish near the support of a rescaled blowup solution.
